A first plan and the child plan it starts when it fills

Source: R/orders_plan_parts_then_part.R
ThenPart.Rd

The then join of a plan: a first plan, and a child plan started once the first one fills.

With each_fill, the child starts on the first plan's first fill, sized to what has filled, and is resized as more fills arrive, which is how a stop or a target follows an entry. A protect or close order in the child works against the side the first plan actually filled on, and when both sides of a two-sided entry filled and the later side filled more, UBI cancels the exits resting on the old side and sends them again on the new side, priced from the fills on the side now held. An exit that has finished is sent again only once its target grows past what it had when it finished, so an exit the exchange cancels is not simply sent again. With on_complete, the child waits until the first plan is done. Give exactly one of the two.

Super class

PlanPart -> ThenPart

Public fields

first

The PlanPart node that runs first.

each_fill

The PlanPart node started on the first fill and resized with every fill, or NULL.

on_complete

The PlanPart node started once the first plan is done, or NULL.

cancel_first_on_child_fill

A logical that is TRUE to cancel whatever of the first plan is still working once the child fills anything.

Methods

Public methods

  • ThenPart$new()

  • ThenPart$document()

  • ThenPart$clone()

ThenPart$new()

Initialises the join with its two plans.

Usage

ThenPart$new(
  first,
  each_fill = NULL,
  on_complete = NULL,
  cancel_first_on_child_fill = FALSE
)

Arguments

first

The PlanPart node that runs first, an OrderPart or another join.

each_fill

The PlanPart node to start on the first fill and resize with every fill, or NULL when on_complete is given.

on_complete

The PlanPart node to start once the first plan is done, or NULL when each_fill is given.

cancel_first_on_child_fill

A logical that is TRUE to cancel whatever of the first plan is still working once the child fills anything.

Returns

A new ThenPart object.

ThenPart$document()

Builds the then node UBI reads.

Usage

ThenPart$document()

Returns

A named list with the single key then, whose value holds first, whichever of each_fill and on_complete is set, and cancel_first_on_child_fill when it is TRUE.

Examples

part <- ThenPart$new(
  first = OrderPart$new(),
  each_fill = OrderPart$new(
    side = "protect",
    pricing = TrailPricing$new(points = 5.0, limit_offset = 1.0)
  )
)
print(part$document())

part <- ThenPart$new(
  first = OrderPart$new(),
  on_complete = OrderPart$new(
    side = "protect",
    pricing = FixedPricing$new(price = 1010.0, order_type = "LIMIT")
  ),
  cancel_first_on_child_fill = TRUE
)
print(part$document())

ThenPart$clone()

The objects of this class are cloneable with this method.

Usage

ThenPart$clone(deep = FALSE)

Arguments

deep

Whether to make a deep clone.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
part <- ThenPart$new(
  first = OrderPart$new(),
  each_fill = OrderPart$new(
    side = "protect",
    pricing = TrailPricing$new(points = 5.0, limit_offset = 1.0)
  )
)
document <- part$document()
} # }
